ovn_nb_db.description: Base URL for the OVN Northbound database (e.g., 'ssl:host:port' or 'unix:/path/to/db.sock')

ovn_sb_db.description: Base URL for the OVN Southbound database (e.g., 'ssl:host:port' or 'unix:/path/to/db.sock')

ovn_nb_ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS for connections to the OVN Northbound database

ovn_sb_ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS for connections to the OVN Southbound database

ovn_ca_cert_path.description: Path to the CA certificate used to verify OVN database server certificates

ovn_client_cert_path.description: Path to the client certificate used for mutual TLS with OVN databases

ovn_client_key_path.description: Path to the client private key used for mutual TLS with OVN databases

host_mac.description: MAC address of this host (e.g., '52:54:00:12:34:56'); set to 'auto' to detect automatically

physical_network_mappings.description: List of physical network to interface mappings (e.g., 'physnet1:eth1')

interface.description: Local network interface name to bind to (e.g., 'eth1')

enable_local_ip_detection.description: Whether to auto-detect the local IP address for tunneling (e.g., using the primary interface); if false, use static local_ip

local_ip.description: Static local IP address for OVN tunneling and chassis identification (only used if auto-detection is disabled)

chassis_external_ids.description: List of key=value pairs to attach as external IDs to the chassis

ovsdb_client_threads.description: Number of worker threads for OVSDB client operations

ovn_controller_threads.description: Number of worker threads for OVN controller processing

ovsdb_connection_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for OVSDB connection establishment
